issue_plain_language.AMBIGUOUS_APPLICABILITY: A rule or note exists but it is not clear where or how it applies.
issue_plain_language.ENGINEERING_METHOD_REQUIRED: The drawings give the requirement but not the method to measure it; the engineer must state the method.
issue_plain_language.MISSING_DETAIL: Something is required by a note or rule but is not drawn or detailed.
issue_plain_language.MISSING_DIMENSION: A size or length needed to measure this is not given.
issue_plain_language.MISSING_SCHEDULE: This member has no schedule row, so its size and bars are not defined.
issue_plain_language.RULE_GAP: A drawing rule does not cover this exact case (for example a value sits exactly on a limit).
issue_plain_language.SOURCE_CONFLICT: Two places on the drawings say different things about the same thing.
issue_plain_language.UNBOUND_OCCURRENCE: A member drawn on the plan cannot be tied to one type mark with certainty.
issue_plain_language.UNIT_CONFLICT: Two sources use different units for the same value.

rules: generated only from the flag and its source references
no structural vocabulary assumed: every glossary term found in the flag text is explained
AutoCAD steps come from the references (text, handle, layer, coordinates)
